# One evolving project record

Copy these headings into your existing `SPEC.md` or link this record from it. Keep one per individual application and one shared group record. Use short, specific notes and links. Future sections can stay unfinished until needed.

## Project and current status

- User/business task; selected scope and what is deferred.
- Current repository, revision/demo and setup.
- Current review stage. Which checks are run, pending or failing?
- Group only: actual member contributions and reviewers.

## 1 · Understand and plan

- Evidence about the need, and assumptions still to check.
- Two feasible approaches; choice, reason and tradeoff.
- Three to five user stories with observable success/failure checks.
- Group: coherent tasks, comparable effort, owners and cross-reviewers.

## 2 · First working slice

- The path that works now, linked code and expected result.
- A real success and failure check; what each establishes.
- Peer observation, issue and response. Work still incomplete.

## 3 · Integrated build

- Current selected/alternate approaches; what stays the same in the comparison.
- Integration and setup checks for this actual revision.
- A real peer's task, observation and the issue to improve next.
- Actual contributions, AI/starter help, and known limits.

## 4 · Improve and hand off

| Record | Your evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Reviewer / date / version | A real person, not an invented peer or AI roleplay. |
| Task | What they tried without coaching. |
| Observation | What happened, including their uncertainty. |
| Decision / change | What you changed and why; link issue/PR. |
| Retest | What happened when tried again; mark not run if pending. |
| Final handoff | Selected live/local version, source revision, setup, actual checks and limits. |

Each final project needs a meaningful feedback change and retest. Keep a Studio skill receipt short: link its code/checks from this same record. Do not copy prompt transcripts or turn an unrun check into a success claim.
